review.why: Set up Better Auth in TypeScript apps: server and client config, database adapters, sessions, plugins and the gotchas that break setups.
review.summary: A configuration guide for Better Auth: a setup workflow, environment variables, core options, adapters (built-in, Drizzle, Prisma, MongoDB), session storage and cookie caching, email flows, hooks, plugins, client imports and a list of common gotchas. It tells the agent to match the documentation to the installed version.
strengths: Starts by pinning documentation to the installed Better Auth version, and separates current from target version when upgrading.
Compact reference with the details that usually bite: model names versus table names, re-running the CLI after plugins, secondary storage and stateless sessions.
Security options are flagged as risks (disabling CSRF or origin checks) instead of being offered as tweaks.
cautions: Reference style: examples are short and most syntax is sent to the online documentation, so the agent needs network access or the Better Auth MCP.
Covers Better Auth only; the repository has no license file, so the license shows as missing.
Read in full but not run here; option names and defaults may change with new Better Auth releases.
